recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-6334 unless a future Patient Care decision changes Condition.abatement[x] datatypes again.
issue_request: FHIR-6334 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care DSTU1 request to make Condition.abatement[x] use dateTime instead of date, matching the timing precision allowed for onset.
initial_application: Git history shows commit 136c952ea9e750c07d05f53e3c98dfecaad7b55b applied #6334 by changing the then-authoritative Condition spreadsheet type from date to dateTime and updating a Condition example from abatementDate to abatementDateTime.
additional_context: Condition is actively built from source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition lists dateTime, Age, Period, Range, and string for both onset[x] and abatement[x], and the abatement date SearchParameter expression explicitly includes Condition.abatement.ofType(dateTime). Later FHIR-13201 history removed abatementBoolean without reversing the dateTime decision. Duplicate Jira reports FHIR-7879, FHIR-7619, and FHIR-7296 ask for the same consistency but do not require separate reconciliation commits.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current build-scope source already implements the requested datatype change and no conflicting community or source evidence was found.
